question: Who is unable to clearly obtain this mantra according to the stated restriction?
premises: This mantra is not obtained by one not born of a yoginī.
It is not obtained by one not Rudra.
inference: Only those qualified as born of a yoginī or as Rudra can clearly obtain this mantra.
uncertainties: The exact qualification implied by na+yoginī+jāto and na+rudro is tradition-specific.
plain_english: One not born of a yoginī and not Rudra does not clearly obtain this.
